riddle: Nagini whispers it, and Lord Voldemort commands it through Parseltongue. In the coding world, it is one of the most beloved languages for beginners, data science, and AI.
hint: Named after a famous reptile (and Monty Python). Famous for clean indentation.

riddle: Aragorn receives the royal bloodline, the blade Andúril, and the crown of Gondor. In Object-Oriented Programming, what mechanism allows a child class to receive properties and methods from its parent class?
hint: One of the 4 pillars of OOP. A subclass ______s from a superclass.

riddle: Nearly Headless Nick floats through Hogwarts corridors as a spirit with no physical form. In code, this keyword represents a variable that exists but intentionally points to no object or memory address.
hint: In C, Java, and JS it is ____; in Python it is called None.

riddle: Harry's Invisibility Cloak hides his body while keeping him functional. In OOP, what core principle bundles data with methods while hiding internal variables using private access modifiers?
hint: Think of enclosing medicine in a capsule. Protected with getters and setters.

riddle: A Boggart morphs into whatever form strikes fear into the viewer. In Object-Oriented Programming, what principle allows a single method name to take multiple forms across different classes?
hint: Greek roots: 'Poly' means many, 'morph' means form.

riddle: Hedwig and Hogwarts owls fly messages between distant wizards. In modern software, this messenger lets two separate applications communicate by sending requests and returning data.
hint: Three letters. Application Programming Interface. REST and GraphQL are popular types.

riddle: Tony Stark keeps his most frequently used tools in quick-draw arm pods so he doesn't have to retrieve them from Avengers tower. In computing, what high-speed temporary storage layer stores recent data for fast retrieval?
hint: Pronounced like 'cash'. L1, L2, and browser versions exist.

riddle: Gandalf searches the grand archives of Minas Tirith by halving the remaining scrolls with each comparison. What logarithmic O(log n) search algorithm divides a sorted collection in half repeatedly?
hint: Two words. Requires an already sorted array. Divide and conquer.

riddle: King T'Challa of Wakanda shares vibranium technology freely with the entire world. In tech, this famous open-source Unix-like operating system kernel powers servers, Android phones, and supercomputers with a penguin mascot.
hint: Created in 1991 by Linus Torvalds. Tux the penguin is its mascot.

riddle: Spider-Man spins clean, lightweight webs between buildings to transport payloads across the city. On the web, what lightweight text format uses curly braces and key-value pairs to exchange data between client and server?
hint: Four letters: JavaScript Object Notation.

riddle: The Alohomora spell unlocks doors, but adding a lock protects the room. On the internet, what secure communication protocol adds TLS encryption to HTTP to safeguard web browsing with a padlock icon?
hint: Five letters. Ends in 'S' for Secure. https://...

riddle: The Map of Middle-earth translates friendly names like 'The Shire' into exact geographical coordinates. On the internet, what system translates human-friendly domain names like google.com into numerical IP addresses?
hint: Three letters. Domain Name System.

riddle: Hyperspace docking stations guide Millennium Falcon flights along safe navigational routes. In home networks and the internet, what hardware device forwards data packets between different networks?
hint: Has antennas. Connects your laptop to your modem or ISP.

riddle: A deceitful Death Eater sends a fake Ministry letter tricking wizards into revealing their Gringotts vault keys. In cybersecurity, what is this fraudulent attempt to steal credentials through deceptive emails called?
hint: Sounds like fishing with a rod, but spelled with 'Ph'.

riddle: Ultron corrupts and infects computers across the globe, replicating uncontrollably to cause damage. In computing, what broad term describes malicious software designed to disrupt, steal, or harm devices?
hint: A portmanteau of 'malicious' and 'software'.

riddle: Thorin Oakenshield carries the ancient Key of Thrór — the single unique key that opens the secret door of Erebor. In a relational database table, what column uniquely identifies each individual row or record?
hint: Two words: ______ Key. Often an auto-incrementing ID or UUID.

riddle: The Grand Army of the Republic counts clone troopers in exact whole numbers like 1, 42, and 66, with no decimal parts. In computer programming, what data type represents whole numbers?
hint: Shortened to 'int' in languages like C++, Java, and Python.

riddle: Calculating the exact fractional hyperdrive speed requires decimals like 0.5 past lightspeed. In programming, what data type represents numbers with fractional decimal points?
hint: Short for floating-point number. Often called 'float' or 'double'.

riddle: Treebeard the ancient Ent stands tall in Fangorn Forest with massive roots and branching limbs. In computer science, what hierarchical data structure consists of a root node, child nodes, and leaves?
hint: Non-linear data structure. Common types include Binary Tree and AVL Tree.

riddle: The machines map all connected human pods with interconnected pathways and nodes. In discrete mathematics and CS, what data structure consists of vertices (nodes) connected by edges?
hint: Can be directed or undirected. Dijkstra searches the shortest path on this.

riddle: J.A.R.V.I.S. acts as the central master software that coordinates Iron Man's thrusters, weapon sensors, display graphics, and memory. In computing, what foundational software manages computer hardware and system resources?
hint: Two words or two letters: OS. Windows, macOS, and Linux are examples.

riddle: Ant-Man shrinks down past the atomic level into eight tiny subatomic particles grouped as one unit. In computing, what unit of digital information consists of a group of 8 bits?
hint: Rhymes with 'bite'. Kilobytes and Megabytes are made of them.

riddle: Hermione scolds Ron: 'It's Levi-O-sa, not Levio-SA!' If a programmer misspells a keyword, forgets a parenthesis, or breaks grammar rules, what kind of error prevents the code from compiling?
hint: Two words: ______ Error. The grammar rules of a programming language.

riddle: Captain America's vibranium shield is forged so its atomic composition never bends or alters. In programming, what keyword declares an immutable variable whose value cannot be reassigned once defined?
hint: Keywords like 'const' or 'final'.

riddle: The Faceless Men of Braavos take any human visage and compress it into a unique, fixed-size mask that cannot be reversed. In computer science, what mathematical function converts arbitrary input data into a fixed-length string of characters?
hint: Used in MD5, SHA-256, and hash tables.

riddle: Hermione flips straight to the index at the back of Hogwarts: A History to locate goblin rebellions in seconds without reading page by page. In databases, what data structure speeds up querying rows on specific columns?
hint: Think of an index in a book. Created with CREATE INDEX on a table.

riddle: Bruce Wayne doesn't build gadgets from raw plastic; Lucius Fox provides pre-assembled foundations, architecture, and libraries. In software development, what pre-built structural platform (like React, Django, or Spring) provides scaffolding for building apps?
hint: Starts with 'F'. Differs from a library because it enforces control flow (inversion of control).

riddle: Behind the simulated illusion of the Matrix, the hidden subterranean machine city of Zion runs the servers, databases, and core power. In web development, what side of an application runs on the server handling business logic and databases?
hint: Opposite of frontend. Node.js, Django, and Spring Boot run here.

riddle: The Matrix renders buildings, streets, and human clothing for the human eye to perceive. In web development, what part of the application consists of the user interface (UI), buttons, and styling that users interact with directly?
hint: Opposite of backend. Built with HTML, CSS, and clientside JavaScript.

riddle: Obi-Wan Kenobi waves his hand and tells the stormtroopers, 'These are not the droids you are looking for.' What famous 3-digit HTTP status code tells web users that the requested page or resource could not be found?
hint: Three numbers: 4_4. Every broken internet link displays this.
